Deskripsi Pekerjaan: Melakukan monitoring dan quality control terhadap kondisi serta fungsi seluruh asset operasional, termasuk kitchen equipment dan equipment pendingin (freezer box, display chiller, AC dan asset terkait lainnya). Memastikan pelaksanaan preventive dan corrective maintenance berjalan sesuai jadwal, standar, dan prosedur yang ditetapkan. Melakukan verifikasi terhadap hasil pekerjaan maintenance untuk memastikan asset dalam kondisi baik, aman, dan layak digunakan. Melakukan inspeksi rutin dan quality control harian terhadap pekerjaan maintenance untuk memastikan aset berfungsi dengan baik, aman, dan layak digunakan. Memastikan hasil pekerjaan teknisi sesuai dengan standar kualitas dan prosedur yang telah ditetapkan. Mengidentifikasi potensi kerusakan, ketidaksesuaian, dan permasalahan aset yang dapat mengganggu kelancaran operasional. Mengomunikasikan permasalahan atau keluhan yang disampaikan oleh tim Operations kepada teknisi terkait serta memastikan tindak lanjut dilakukan sesuai prioritas. Melakukan monitoring terhadap keluhan yang diajukan oleh tim Operations dan memastikan penyelesaiannya sesuai kebutuhan operasional. Berkoordinasi dengan tim internal dan vendor untuk memastikan efektivitas pelaksanaan maintenance serta menjaga reliability dan availability aset. Melakukan inspeksi lapangan secara mobile dan merespons permasalahan operasional yang membutuhkan penanganan segera. Mengidentifikasi, mendokumentasikan, serta memonitor tindak lanjut atas temuan kerusakan atau ketidaksesuaian asset. Berkoordinasi dengan tim terkait dan vendor dalam memastikan efektivitas pemeliharaan serta menjaga reliability dan availability asset. Melakukan pekerjaan administrasi terkait kegiatan pemeliharaan asset, termasuk pengelolaan dokumen, laporan, checklist, histori maintenance, dan monitoring data asset. Mengelola dan memperbarui data monitoring maintenance menggunakan Microsoft Excel atau Google Sheets. Monitoring kinerja OB dan Teknisi Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal SMK, diutamakan dari jurusan Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro, Teknik Industri, atau bidang terkait, dengan pengalaman bekerja min. 1 tahun Mampu melakukan monitoring, analisa yang kuat, dan tindak lanjut terhadap temuan atau permasalahan asset. Memiliki kemampuan Microsoft Office, khususnya Microsoft Excel. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik dengan tim internal maupun vendor. Teliti, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, memiliki kemampuan problem solving, dan memiliki perhatian terhadap detail. Memahami dasar-dasar K3 dan keselamatan kerja menjadi nilai tambah. Bersedia melakukan inspeksi dan monitoring asset di area operasional sesuai kebutuhan serta mampu merespons keadaan darurat operasional dengan cepat. Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 1 tahun di bidang Quality Control, Maintenance, Engineering, Asset Management, atau posisi terkait. Memahami dasar pengetahuan tentang preventive dan corrective maintenance dengan asset terkait. Memiliki kemampuan administrasi dan dokumentasi yang baik, termasuk pengelolaan checklist, laporan, histori maintenance, dan data asset. Bersedia bekerja on-site dan mobile di area Jakarta Timur

Proficiency in Go, including API development with OpenAPI, testing, concurrency, and error handling. Practical experience building production interfaces with React or Next.js and TypeScript. Membuat dan meninjau dokumen teknik seperti Piping and Instrumentation Diagram (P&ID). Menentukan spesifikasi teknis untuk alat ukur ( instruments ), katup kendali ( control valves ), dan sistem keamanan ( ESD/Emergency Shutdown, DCS/Distributed Control System, F&G/Fire & Gas ). Membuat lembar data instrumen ( instrument data sheets ), diagram loop , dan daftar kebutuhan material ( Bill of Quantity / BoQ ). Menyiapkan dokumen permintaan penawaran ( request for quotation ) untuk vendor. Melakukan evaluasi teknis terhadap penawaran dari vendor atau penyuplai alat. Berkoordinasi dengan bagian pengadaan untuk memastikan peralatan sesuai dengan standar industri migas (seperti API, IEC, atau ISA). Memastikan parameter penting seperti suhu ( temperature ), tekanan ( pressure ), tingkat cairan ( level ), dan aliran ( flow ) terpantau secara akurat oleh sistem kontrol. Mengatasi masalah ( troubleshooting ) pada perangkat instrumen atau sistem kendali yang mengalami kerusakan untuk mencegah downtime atau shutdown pabrik. Mengatur jadwal dan prosedur kalibrasi alat ukur agar tetap presisi dan memenuhi standar keselamatan kerja. Memastikan sistem pengaman darurat berfungsi dengan baik guna mencegah kecelakaan kerja atau ledakan (seperti Pressure Safety Valves / PSV). Bekerja sama dengan disiplin ilmu lain seperti insinyur proses ( process engineer ), mekanik, dan kelistrikan ( electrical ) Pendidikan minimal Gelar Sarjana S1 : lulusan Teknik Instrumentasi, Teknik Fisika, Teknik Elektro, atau Teknik Kontrol. Memahami dan menguasai sistem seperti PLC ( Programmable Logic Controller ), DCS ( Distributed Control System ), SCADA, dan ESD ( Emergency Shutdown ). Mengerti fungsi instrumen seperti transmitter , control valve , sensor, dan detektor. Mampu membaca serta membuat P&ID ( Piping and Instrumentation Diagram ), Instrument Index , dan Loop Diagrams . Terbiasa menggunakan AutoCAD serta alat kalibrasi seperti multimeter dan HART communicator . Mampu mendiagnosis gangguan sistem dan menguji keandalan alat. Berkoordinasi dengan baik bersama teknisi, manajemen, maupun divisi lain.

SAP Consultant – All Modules Job Responsibilities Analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP solutions. Perform SAP implementation, configuration, and customization based on business needs. Provide end-user support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution related to SAP systems. Conduct system testing (SIT/UAT) to ensure all functions run properly. Prepare functional specifications, business process documentation, and user manuals. Collaborate with technical teams, developers, and stakeholders for system enhancements and integrations. Deliver user training and knowledge sharing sessions. Monitor and improve existing business processes within SAP systems. Support data migration, system integration, and enhancement activities. Ensure SAP projects are delivered according to project timelines and requirements. Handle incident management and change requests from users/business teams. Support go-live activities and provide post-implementation support. SAP Modules SAP FI/CO (Finance & Controlling) SAP MM (Material Management) SAP SD (Sales & Distribution) SAP PP (Production Planning) SAP HCM / SuccessFactors SAP WM/EWM SAP PM SAP QM SAP ABAP / Technical SAP Basis Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or related fields. Minimum 3 years of experience as an SAP Consultant in at least one SAP module. Strong knowledge of SAP implementation, configuration, and business process analysis. Experience in handling end-to-end SAP project implementation and support activities. Familiar with SAP integration processes across different modules. Able to perform system testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution effectively. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills to interact with users and stakeholders. Experience in preparing functional documentation and conducting user training. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment. Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA is an advantage. Good command of English, both written and spoken. Willing to work under project deadlines and dynamic environments.

About The Roles Make sure that every kilo a collector brings in is received, weighed, paid, and delivered onward — reliably, cheaply, and with data that holds up under audit. The Manager of Operations owns Wahu's physical capacity: how many collection points exist, whether they work, and how material moves from hub to MRF. Growth creates the demand; this role makes sure the network can absorb it. Job Descriptions Network build — hubs & dropboxes Owns the rollout plan against the 400–500 collection point target: site selection, partner onboarding, permits, installation, and launch readiness. Builds a repeatable installation process so opening a hub is a standard procedure, not a project. Manages the pipeline per partner and per region, phased against transport and MRF processing capacity no hub opens that cannot be serviced. Proposes relocation or closure of underperforming points on cost and uptime evidence, with Growth consulted on whether demand can still be built. Delivers a hub that is ready to receive collectors on the agreed launch date, so Growth's pre-launch campaign lands on a working site. Hub operations — uptime and the collector experience on site Analyze and optimized hub for improvement Owns hub uptime: equipment working, scales calibrated, bins emptied, site clean and safe. Staffs and trains hub attendants; sets the service standard a collector meets at the counter. Owns payout execution accurate weighing, correct rates (e.g. Rp 10,000/kg for aluminium cans), and payment into the app wallet without disputes. Runs preventive maintenance and a fast-response repair loop; a broken hub is a lost hub. Resolves partner-side issues at store level: space, access, signage, store staff cooperation. Logistics & collection Owns routing, collection frequency, fleet, and third-party transport so no hub overflows and no truck runs half empty. Plans capacity ahead of the rollout and ahead of campaign peaks flagged by Growth. Manages transport cost per kilo as a primary lever on unit economics. Owns chain-of-custody from hub to MRF — every load traceable to a source. Alignment with the MRF Coordinates with the MRF on delivery windows, intake planning, and volume forecasts. This is alignment between two organisations, not line management. Holds material quality at the handover: sorted, dry, and within agreed contamination limits so volume is not lost at the gate. Gives the MRF a reliable forward forecast so processing capacity is planned ahead of the rollout, not after it. Flags early when network volume is about to outgrow available processing capacity. Resolves handover disputes on weight, quality, and documentation. Cost, data & compliance Owns all-in operational cost per kilo, hub to MRF collection, transport, handling, payout and drives it down as volume scales. Owns the operational data layer feeding the dashboard: volumes, weights, uptime, routes, deliveries. One source of truth, shared with Growth and Finance. Guards traceability so volume claims survive audit by partners, certifiers, and plastic-credit markets (PPRS, PCX Markets). Owns permits, KLHK and other regulatory reporting, and QHSE across all sites. Owns safety: this is a business with vehicles, machinery, and manual handling. Qualification Track record: 8+ years in operations or logistics, of which at least 3 leading a multi-site field organisation. Leads managers: has run a network through city, area, or branch managers — not a single site, and not only an office function. Comfortable being accountable for places they are not standing in. Scale of people: has been responsible for 100+ staff, including blue-collar teams. Standardisation: has taken something that worked in one location and made it work identically in five. Indonesian market: operates confidently with local permits, regulators, retail partners, and vendors across regions. Cost discipline: has owned a unit cost and moved it. Can build and defend an operational model. Language: fluent Bahasa Indonesi

About Astro ASTRO is Indonesia's quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. Founded in 2021 by a group of seasoned e-commerce executives and is backed trusted international investors, it is our mission to make people's lives simpler and easier by saving them time, energy, and money. Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced. Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission! About this Position This role focuses on leading a scalable backend services improvement to support our cross platform. You will collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to lead the delivery of new features, optimize databases and system performance, and maintain reliable service communication through RPC and messaging systems. You will also research engineering best practices to ensure system stability and efficiency. Responsibilities Collaborating with stakeholders and product managers to define project goals and priorities. Mentoring and developing the engineers, performing code reviews, and enforcing best practices. Translate product requirements into clear technical solutions and actionable development tasks for your team. Break down complex engineering problems into manageable components and estimate development efforts accurately. Oversee backend features delivery in collaboration with the Product team, ensuring timely and high-quality implementation. Take ownership of the full product lifecycle, including development, testing, deployment to production, and continuous improvements or fixes. Explore and leverage AI tools or technologies to improve development efficiency and support practical implementation in daily engineering workflows. Minimum 5–6 years of experience as a Software Engineer, with strong exposure to backend system development. Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience using Golang to build and maintain backend services or distributed systems. Solid experience working with Redis for caching, RPC or service-to-service communication, and message queue systems such as Kafka or similar technologies. Strong understanding of database technologies, including both SQL and NoSQL, with the ability to design efficient data models and optimize queries. Experience in system design, including building scalable, reliable, and fault-tolerant systems. Familiar with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana and Datadog to monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues. Good understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) best practices, including testing, deployment, and maintenance. Ability to perform performance benchmarking, monitoring, and system optimization to ensure system reliability and efficiency. Possesses a curious and proactive mindset, continuously seeking feedback, learning new technologies, and exploring broader perspectives to improve engineering practices.

judul: Network & IoT Officer at PT Kawasan Industri Terpadu Batang member of PT Danareksa Persero
teks: Operasional Infrastruktur Digital Mengoperasikan jaringan internet, fiber optic, WiFi zone, dan infrastruktur IoT yang menjadi lingkup layanan departemen. Memastikan layanan konektivitas berjalan sesuai kebutuhan tenant dan operasional kawasan. Menjaga ketersediaan layanan infrastruktur digital pada kondisi operasional normal. Monitoring Jaringan dan IoT Memantau kondisi jaringan, perangkat konektivitas, dan node/perangkat IoT secara berkala. Mengidentifikasi gangguan, penurunan performa, atau anomali pada sistem jaringan dan IoT. Mencatat hasil monitoring sebagai dasar tindakan korektif dan evaluasi. Pemeliharaan Infrastruktur Digital Melaksanakan preventive maintenance pada perangkat jaringan dan infrastruktur IoT. Memastikan perangkat digital dalam kondisi siap operasi. Mencatat hasil pemeliharaan untuk kebutuhan histori peralatan dan evaluasi. Penanganan Gangguan Jaringan dan IoT Mengidentifikasi penyebab gangguan konektivitas, jaringan, atau perangkat IoT. Melakukan tindakan awal perbaikan dan pemulihan layanan digital. Berkoordinasi dengan vendor atau pihak terkait untuk penanganan lanjutan bila diperlukan. Pengamanan dan Keandalan Infrastruktur Digital Memastikan konfigurasi dasar dan operasional perangkat mendukung keamanan dan keandalan layanan. Mengidentifikasi potensi risiko operasional pada jaringan dan perangkat digital. Menyampaikan kebutuhan tindak lanjut terkait keamanan dan reliability kepada atasan atau pihak terkait. Dukungan Layanan Digital Mendukung kebutuhan teknis tenant atau unit terkait terhadap layanan jaringan dan IoT. Menindaklanjuti keluhan atau gangguan layanan digital di lapangan. Berkoordinasi dengan fungsi proyek atau vendor untuk memastikan kelancaran layanan. Pelaporan Operasional Infrastruktur Digital Mengisi logsheet operasional jaringan dan IoT. Menyusun laporan gangguan, maintenance, dan kondisi infrastruktur digital. Menyampaikan laporan operasional sebagai bahan monitoring dan evaluasi atasan. Manajemen dan Mitigasi Risiko Melakukan identifikasi, pengelolaan, pelaporan, kontrol, dan evaluasi mitigasi risiko secara berkala dengan memperhatikan target dan kebijakan risiko sesuai alur proses bisnis dan faktornya, serta memperhatikan aspek risiko dalam setiap keputusan dan ikut dalam program pengembangan budaya risiko. Diploma (D3) atau Sarjana (S1) di bidang Teknik Informatika, Teknik Telekomunikasi, Teknik Elektro, atau bidang lain yang relevan. Minimal 3–5 tahun pengalaman dalam pengelolaan jaringan komunikasi, IoT network, atau infrastruktur digital. Jaringan Komunikasi dan Fiber Optic : Pemahaman dalam instalasi, konfigurasi, dan pengelolaan jaringan fiber optic dan internet kawasan IoT Network dan Sistem Sensor : Pengetahuan dalam implementasi jaringan IoT seperti LoRaWAN serta integrasi perangkat sensor. Manajemen Infrastruktur Jaringan : Pemahaman dalam monitoring, maintenance, dan troubleshooting jaringan digital. Keamanan Jaringan (Network Security) : Pengetahuan dalam menjaga keamanan sistem jaringan dan data. Sistem Monitoring dan Kontrol : Pemahaman dalam penggunaan tools monitoring jaringan dan performa sistem. Keandalan dan Kontinuitas Layanan : Kemampuan dalam menjaga uptime dan kualitas layanan jaringan. Pemeliharaan dan Troubleshooting : Kemampuan dalam mengidentifikasi dan menyelesaikan gangguan jaringan dan IoT system

judul: Hospital Coordinator Sumatera Utara dan Aceh
teks: Kitabisa sedang mencari Hospital Coordinator untuk wilayah Sumatera Utara dan Aceh. Kamu akan menjadi penghubung utama antara Kitabisa dengan rumah sakit, klinik, komunitas, dan instansi kesehatan untuk membantu pasien yang membutuhkan biaya pengobatan melalui penggalangan dana. Peran ini cocok untuk kamu yang senang turun ke lapangan, membangun relasi, dan ingin berdampak langsung bagi pasien. Tanggung Jawab Mencari dan mendapatkan pasien (supply) melalui rekomendasi rumah sakit, klinik, komunitas, dan instansi kesehatan. Mencari pasien secara personal melalui pendekatan direct selling di lapangan. Membuat campaign penggalangan dana untuk pasien, baik dari jalur rekomendasi maupun direct selling. Menggali informasi dari pasien dan keluarga, serta menindaklanjuti kebutuhan aset (dokumen, foto, cerita, data medis) untuk memaksimalkan performa campaign. Membangun dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan rumah sakit, klinik, komunitas, dan instansi kesehatan di wilayah Sumatera Utara dan Aceh. Bertanggung jawab atas proses pembayaran billing ke rumah sakit, klinik, komunitas, dan instansi kesehatan. Menyusun laporan pencairan dana untuk dilaporkan kepada pihak rumah sakit, klinik, komunitas, dan instansi kesehatan terkait. Pendidikan minimal S1 dari semua jurusan; diutamakan Kesehatan Masyarakat, Keperawatan, Kesejahteraan Sosial, Komunikasi, atau bidang terkait. Berdomisili di Sumatera Utara (diutamakan Medan) atau Aceh, dan bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas antar kota/kabupaten di kedua provinsi. Pengalaman di bidang hospital relations, medical representative, sales lapangan, pekerjaan sosial, atau NGO menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki jaringan dengan rumah sakit, klinik, atau komunitas kesehatan di Sumatera Utara/Aceh menjadi nilai tambah. Kemampuan komunikasi dan negosiasi yang baik, serta empati tinggi dalam berinteraksi dengan pasien dan keluarganya. Mampu bekerja mandiri dengan target, proaktif, dan teliti dalam administrasi serta pelaporan. Terbiasa menggunakan smartphone, Google Workspace/Microsoft Office, dan media sosial. Memiliki kendaraan pribadi dan SIM aktif menjadi nilai tambah. Menguasai bahasa daerah setempat (Batak, Aceh, dll.) menjadi nilai tambah.

Mempelajari dokumen Request for Quotation (RFQ), Invitation to Tender (ITT), spesifikasi teknis, gambar desain teknik, serta dokumen Scope of Work (SOW) dari pemilik proyek (misalnya KKKS atau perusahaan minyak multinasional). Menghitung secara detail volume material khusus migas (seperti pipa khusus, katup/valves, struktur platform, instrumen skid ) serta kebutuhan tenaga kerja ahli ( welder bersertifikat, piping engineer , dll). Menentukan standar harga untuk setiap satuan pekerjaan berdasarkan kompleksitas medan (misalnya proyek onshore vs offshore ). Menghubungi vendor dan sub-kontraktor untuk mendapatkan penawaran harga material, sewa alat berat (seperti crane barge , mesin drilling ), atau jasa penunjang migas. Mengevaluasi penawaran vendor untuk memastikan spesifikasi material telah memenuhi standar keselamatan migas internasional (seperti ASME, API, atau ASTM) dengan harga terbaik. Proyek oil & gas sangat sensitif terhadap perubahan cuaca, fluktuasi harga komoditas, dan regulasi ketat. Estimator harus cermat memasukkan biaya risiko dan dana darurat agar proyek tidak rugi di tengah jalan. Menganalisis jenis kontrak yang ditawarkan (misalnya Lump Sum , Unit Price , atau Cost-Plus ) guna memetakan potensi risiko komersial bagi perusahaan. Menggabungkan seluruh komponen biaya (material, jasa, overhead , keuntungan, dan pajak) ke dalam dokumen penawaran harga akhir untuk diajukan ke klien. About the Role VIDA verifies identity in real time for financial services, lending, telecommunications, and government-linked services. This makes us a target for organised fraud operations that spoof genuine users and devices at scale — and adapt within days when a defence starts working. Detection here is a continuing contest, and errors cost in both directions: missed fraud harms users and customers, while false positives deny real people access to services. You will own detection on this path: investigate attacks in raw device and behavioural telemetry, build the rules and ML models that catch them, and measure what they catch and what they cost genuine users. The data is high-dimensional and noisy, labels are scarce and delayed, and decisions must be explainable. What You Will Do Understand the adversary Investigate real attacks — reconstruct how a campaign operates from the evidence available, and characterise it well enough that we can act on it. Find signal in high-dimensional, messy data — work across large volumes of device and behavioural telemetry to identify what genuinely separates fraudulent activity from legitimate users. Keep pace with change — when an adversary adapts, quickly establish what changed and what still distinguishes them. Build detection that holds up Design detection logic and models — from feature engineering through training, calibration, and threshold selection, choosing the right tool for the problem: interpretable logic where explainability matters, models where they earn their place. Detect coordinated activity, not just single events — move detection beyond judging each request in isolation toward recognising organised behaviour across many, which is far harder for an adversary to disguise. Balance detection against user impact — treat the false-positive cost to genuine users as a first-class constraint, measured on the real population before anything is enforced. Own quality in production — validate before enforcement, monitor for drift and degradation, and know when to roll back. Make the evidence trustworthy Build and improve ground truth — establish reliable labels in a domain where they are scarce, delayed, and imperfect, and be clear about what your labels do and do not cover. Hold a high evidential bar — recall and false-positive rates measured on the right populations, class imbalance, selection bias, and correctness of point-in-time evaluation. You should be able to spot the ways an analysis can flatter itself, and design around them. Make the work reproducible and legible — analysis and specifications that colleagues can re-run, challenge, and build on. Partner closely with fraud operations, engineering, and product — and communicate findings clearly to non-specialists, including when the honest answer is uncomfortable. Strong SQL on large datasets — comfortable and effective in large, messy event data. Fluent Python data-science stack — pandas, scikit-learn, and gradient-boosted trees, with clean and reproducible analysis. Genuine evaluation rigour — you understand why a model can look excellent offline and fail in production: label leakage, selection bias, drift, class imbalance, and the difference between conditioned and population-level error rates. Feature engineering from raw, semi-structured data — turning noisy, high-cardinality inputs into signals that hold up over time. An adversarial mindset — you instinctively ask how someone would evade what you built, and you design accordingly. Deskripsi Pekerjaan Menganalisis kebutuhan bisnis dari pengguna atau unit bisnis dan menerjemahkannya ke dalam pendekatan analisis data. Mengeksplorasi dan menganalisis data untuk mengidentifikasi pola, tren, dan insight utama. Melaksanakan UAT (User Acceptance Testing), memberikan dukungan pada proses deployment bersama pengguna, serta mendokumentasikan hasil analisis. Menganalisis tingkat akurasi model data secara berkala dan melakukan fine-tuning apabila diperlukan. Merancang dan menyajikan visualisasi data serta dashboard yang informatif sesuai dengan kebutuhan pengguna. Memastikan dokumentasi administrasi tersusun dengan baik serta menyusun standardisasi aturan dan prosedur formal. Persyaratan Pendidikan minimal S1 di bidang Data Science, Ilmu Komputer, Teknologi Informasi, Matematika, Statistika, atau bidang kuantitatif lain yang relevan. Memiliki pemahaman yang kuat mengenai machine learning dan predictive modeling, serta mampu mengembangkan model secara end-to-end, mulai dari persiapan data, feature engineering, pengembangan model, hingga evaluasi. Menguasai SQL untuk melakukan ekstraksi, manipulasi, dan analisis data dari berbagai sumber data. Memahami konsep Big Data dan data warehouse, serta mampu bekerja dengan dataset berskala besar. Mampu melakukan exploratory data analysis (EDA) untuk memahami karakteristik data, mengidentifikasi pola maupun anomali, serta menghasilkan insight yang bermakna. judul: GoTo Financial - Senior Risk Analyst - Gopay Lending
teks: About The Role This role is central to our Credit Risk Strategy for merchant lending products including Gopay Pinjam Modal (GPPM) and Toko Kapital. Key challenges include balancing portfolio growth with risk mitigation and navigating complex merchant data to inform actionable decisions. The person will be expected to assist in managing credit underwriting and account management. In order to support the deliverables, this person is also expected to quickly learn internal risk frameworks, establish relationships with key business stakeholders, and contribute to risk analysis and strategy execution. What You Will Do Monitor and analyze key merchant risk metrics to uncover underlying trends and provide actionable insights. Evaluate and optimize current credit risk policies to ensure robust portfolio health and risk mitigation. Leverage SQL and Python to analyze complex datasets, driving continuous strategy enhancements and executing them via decision engines. Partner with cross-functional business teams to guide and support data-driven lending decisions. Develop and maintain comprehensive risk dashboards to facilitate accurate, real-time reporting for stakeholders. Facilitate periodic credit reviews and internal audits to ensure compliance and uphold risk standards. Drive process improvement initiatives within the Credit Risk team to enhance overall operational efficiency. What You Will Need At least 3 years of experience in credit risk management. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Understanding of credit risk principles and lending products. Experience with data analysis tools (SQL/PYTHON, Excel, or BI tools). Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. Attention to detail and strong organizational skills. Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks. About The Team As a pivotal member of the Credit Risk function, this role manages merchant lending products, monitors portfolio health, and ensures policy compliance. A central objective is to strategically balance business growth with risk mitigation through the interpretation of complex merchant data. The role Turn business intent into requirements that engineers can build and QA can test. This is hands-on specification engineering. You report to the CEO and work with the CTO, QA, engineers and business counterparts. You own editorial precision. Changes to approved business meaning, scope or architecture go to the relevant business authority, the CEO or the CTO. This is not a product-owner or roadmap role. You will not own the roadmap, pricing or revenue targets. You will own the requirements: what the system must do, where each rule came from, who approved it, and how QA can prove it. Your first assignment is a fund management platform. If you are a senior Business Analyst, System Analyst, Requirements Engineer or technical Product Owner, and you value precision more than slide decks, this role is for you. What you will do Discovery and user understanding Plan and run stakeholder interviews, workflow discovery and user research to find goals, constraints, exceptions and unmet needs. Turn findings into clear problem statements, user journeys and priorities. Validate proposed flows and usability with intended users before they become build commitments. Requirements and decisions Write versioned requirements with an ID, source evidence, approval record, explicit dependencies and acceptance criteria that QA can turn into positive, negative and boundary cases. Turn ambiguity or contradiction into a decision request: the issue, the evidence, the decision owner, your proposed default and the requested action. Keep a decision ledger, so that no ruling stays informal. Keep scope, open questions and approved decisions visible to engineering and business stakeholders. Product design and delivery alignment Shape user flows, interaction requirements and usability acceptance criteria with engineering and business counterparts. Keep module boundaries and traceability current after approved semantic changes. Make the implementation impact visible before a boundary changes. QA and engineering handoff Give QA the exact approved revision, acceptance basis and dependencies before the affected build starts. Resolve or escalate the material testability gaps that QA returns. The affected build stays blocked until the gap is resolved or its approval owner excludes that scope. AI-enabled practice Use AI to draft and reconcile specifications. Check every AI-drafted clause against its source, and document your method. Improve the tools and templates that keep requirements, decisions and traceability easy to maintain, such as ID issuance, traceability and contradiction checks. What you need 5+ years of business analysis, specification engineering or product experience, delivering enterprise transactional or approval-driven systems from discovery through release. Strong user-research skills: you plan interviews and workflow observations, separate evidence from assumptions, and turn findings into user journeys and requirements. Practical UX understanding: clear navigation, interaction states, error recovery and accessibility. You can assess wireframes or prototypes and validate usability with intended users. Precise requirement writing and decision discipline. QA can test your acceptance criteria without asking what you meant. You read data models, API contracts and tests with engineers, and you reason about delivery trade-offs. Clear written and spoken Bahasa Indonesia and English, including facilitation of stakeholder reviews and decisions. Practical AI proficiency, with source verification and a documented method. Nice to have 7+ years of relevant experience. Financial-industry experience: fund management, custody, securities settlement, banking or payments. B2B delivery with a client-side sign-off chain. You have shipped a product built on a language model.

The Australia-Indonesia Partnership for Health Transformation (KITA SEHAT) is a joint initiative between the Governments of Australia and Indonesia to support the transformation of Indonesia’s human and animal health systems, policy, and governance. The program runs for eight years (2025–2033), with total funding of up to AUD 100 million. Phase 1 runs from August 2025 to June 2029, investing about AUD 50 million. Phase 2 will extend the program out to 2033, pending agreement between the Governments of Australia and Indonesia. KITA SEHAT is funded and managed by Australia’s Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) and implemented by DT Global. Indonesia's Ministry of National Development Planning/National Development Planning Agency (Kementerian PPN/ Bappenas ) is the primary coordinating ministry for the program, in partnership with the Ministry of Health, the Ministry of Agriculture and subnational governments in Jawa Barat, Nusa Tenggara Timur and Papua Barat Daya. The program works towards four end-of-program outcomes (EOPOs): Primary health care policy and governance – by 2033, national and selected subnational authorities have adopted improved primary health policies, service delivery approaches and governance arrangements. Primary health services – by 2033, selected subnational authorities have improved the quality of and access to primary health services with a focus on stunting prevention and the inclusion of women, people with disability and other marginalised groups. Health system enablers – by 2033, national and selected subnational authorities have enhanced core workforce capabilities in critical human and animal health system enabling functions. Health security – by 2033, national and selected subnational authorities have increased capacity for health security and animal health policy development, strategic planning and the assessment, mitigation and management of acute and emerging health threats. KITA SEHAT is designed to address local priorities, ensure women and people with disabilities are central to health system change, and to build climate resilience into how that change is delivered. McEasy, a transportation management solution to simplify complex logistics operations. is looking for a IoT Data Lead to join our ever-growing team. As IoT Data Lead, you will own the correctness of device data end to end, from the moment it enters McEasy’s platform to the moment a customer sees it. You will work across the IoT, data platform and SaaS teams without managing them directly, and hold the decision authority on how device data is defined, processed and changed. Be the final decision-maker on how device data is defined, interpreted and stored (units, sources, fields, logic) Own the data contract and keep it complete, consistent and agreed by the IoT, data platform and SaaS teams Resolve conflicts between technical documents and product requirements Answer open cross-team questions within an agreed timeframe, and bring clear recommendations when leadership input is needed Keep a decision log with each decision, its reason and who it affects Review and approve processing logic changes, schema changes and new device integrations before release Check downstream dependencies (features, reports, fields) before approving any data change Maintain a single register of processing rules and settings, including what each does, who sets it and who depends on it Create and maintain a standard onboarding checklist for new devices (fields, timezones, units, buffering, test cases) Make sure new devices are verified on our own platform, and feed post-release issues back into the checklist Take ownership of escalated issues where the root cause is unclear or moves between teams Make sure customer issues are closed on fixes that actually shipped Work closely with engineers, Product Owners and QA, and explain technical decisions clearly to non-technical teams Qualification: Experienced in IoT, telematics, data engineering or backend engineering Hands-on understanding of the full device data path: device protocols (e.g. GPS, OBD/CAN), data ingestion, data processing, and how applications consume the data Proven track record of making technical decisions that other teams adopt, without formal authority over them Ability to write clear requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria that engineers can build and test against Comfortable saying “no” or “not yet” to changes that aren’t ready, and explaining why Ability to structure ambiguous cross-team problems and decide who needs to be involved, and in what order Strong written communication in English [and Bahasa Indonesia] Experience with data contracts, schema governance or multi-vendor device integration is a plus Background in mechatronics, electronics or electrical engineering is a plus Additional Notes: This is not a people management role. The IoT, data platform and SaaS teams keep their own leads, hiring and performance reviews. You decide and verify, while the teams build. This role is not expected to build all processing logic yourself. You define acceptance criteria and sign off on changes, but independent testing stays with the QA team. This role does not cover UI, firmware development or hardware design. You are expected to scale your decisions through clear rules and checklists, so routine approvals don’t depend on you. About Us Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot. We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios. We're looking for an ambitious Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you. Build Products End-to-End Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production. Create Powerful Automations Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements. Develop AI-Powered Features Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently. Connect the Ecosystem Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem. Solve Real Operational Problems Build Solutions For Real-time reservation and availability synchronization Dynamic pricing intelligence Smart lock access and key management Automated guest communication across channels Guest check-in and upsell journeys Operational forecasting Cleaning and maintenance automation Owner reporting and financial workflows AI-powered monitoring and alerts Measure and Improve Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes. Build for Scale Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform. Role Overview As a Backend Engineer at Floq, you will build and maintain the services that connect our exchange to the outside world. Floq is an OJK-licensed cryptocurrency exchange, and the systems you work on sit at the seams where money and identity move between parties: payment gateways that bring rupiah in and out, the KYC engine that verifies who our users are, and the trade engine that executes their orders. Your mission is to write clean, reliable Go services on AWS that make these integrations behave predictably under real load and real failure. Third-party APIs will time out, webhooks will arrive twice or out of order, and vendors will change their contracts. Your job is to make sure none of that ever reaches a user's balance or a regulator's report. Core Responsibilities Integration Engineering: Design, build, and maintain Go services that integrate with payment gateways (virtual accounts, bank transfers, e-wallets), KYC and identity verification providers, and Floq's trade engine and liquidity connectors. Transactional Integrity: Implement deposit, withdrawal, and order lifecycles as explicit state machines with clear ownership of every transition, so a payment is never credited twice and never lost. Reconciliation & Observability: Build automated reconciliation jobs against gateway settlement reports and trade engine fills, and instrument services with CloudWatch, structured logging, and alerting so anomalies surface before users notice. Security & Compliance: Handle credentials and PII correctly (Secrets Manager, KMS, IAM least privilege, encrypted data at rest and in transit) and work with the security and compliance teams to meet OJK and data protection requirements. Collaboration: Partner with mobile and web engineers on API contracts, with Product on integration scope, and with QA on test environments and vendor sandboxes. Technical Requirements Experience: 3+ years of professional backend development, with production Go (Golang) as your primary language for at least 2 of them. Go Proficiency: Solid command of idiomatic Go, including goroutines and channels, context propagation, error handling patterns, interfaces for testability, and Go modules. AWS Stack: Hands-on experience deploying and operating services on AWS, ideally Lambda-first: API Gateway, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, DynamoDB, RDS (PostgreSQL), S3, CloudWatch, IAM. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or SAM) is expected. Integration Experience: You have built against at least one external API that mattered, such as a payment gateway, banking API, identity provider, or exchange/matching engine, and you understand webhooks, signature verification, idempotency keys, and rate limiting from the inside. Data & Storage: Comfortable with relational modeling and transaction semantics in PostgreSQL, plus practical use of DynamoDB or Redis for high-throughput access patterns. Testing & Tooling: Unit and integration testing in Go, contract or mock testing against vendor sandboxes, Git, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CodePipeline, or similar). Bonus: Experience with FIX or WebSocket-based trading APIs, gRPC, or building financial ledgers; exposure to Indonesian payment rails (BI-FAST, QRIS, virtual accounts from local banks) is a strong plus. teks: We're hiring a Lead Product Engineer to own the platform that wraps our AI agents: the customer portal, the live meeting experience, onboarding, billing, admin, and reporting. This is a hands-on, player-coach role: you will eventually lead engineers, but first and foremost you ship. Most of what users and paying customers touch outside the agent conversation itself is yours — and much of it is driven directly by commercial needs, where a small, well-built feature can unblock a deal the same week it's requested. While our Agent Core team obsesses over how the AI behaves, you obsess over everything around it: can a customer build, deploy, share, monitor and bill for their agents without friction? The platform is where Kulu stops being a clever demo and becomes a product a business runs on. About Kulu Kulu is a high-performance, high-bandwidth communication team. We run live daily standups, Slack constantly, and jump into huddles rather than letting long async threads develop. Product, engineering and commercial conversations overlap heavily. This suits people who enjoy working closely with highly engaged colleagues, talking through hard problems in real time, sharing unfinished work, and moving quickly as new information emerges. It's probably not the right environment if your ideal style is to receive a well-defined problem, disappear for the day, and communicate primarily through async updates. There will be focused individual work — but we optimize for the speed and quality of the team as a whole. We are deliberately moving toward a more in-person culture in Bali, and this role will help build a high-performance office culture where exceptional engineers want to work. Tasks You will be the technical owner of the Kulu platform — responsible for turning product and commercial priorities into shipped, polished features, fast. End-to-end feature delivery — Take user stories from a conversation with the CEO to production: portal features, the meeting frontend, agent configuration and deployment flows, dashboards and reporting, org and seat management, plans and billing. You own the full slice — frontend, backend API, data model. Product judgment in the details — Many requests arrive as a sentence, not a spec ("highlight the Scale plan as most popular", "customers need escalation policies"). You fill the gap with judgment: what's the smallest version that's genuinely good, what edge cases matter, what will confuse a customer. You work directly with the founders and are expected to push back when a request is the wrong shape. Commercial responsiveness — Platform work is often deal-driven: a customer rollout blocked on an org-management feature, a compliance requirement, a pricing page change needed for a live negotiation. You triage these against roadmap work and ship the urgent ones in days, not sprints — without breaking things. Platform architecture — Keep the wrapper clean as it grows: clear API contracts with the agent engine, sane data models, feature-flagged rollouts, frontend code that the next engineer can extend. You inherit a working production system; your job is to make it better with every change, not to rewrite it. Quality without ceremony — We don't measure you on process. We measure you on whether platform features ship quickly and then don't come back as bugs. You decide where tests, flags and staged rollouts earn their keep. Leading the platform team — A full-stack engineer will join the team under you as we grow. You'll assign ownership, review work, give frequent feedback, and own the team's output and development. What success looks like The North Star: does the platform ship what the business needs, fast, at a quality that builds customer trust? Success in the first months looks like: you own the portal and meeting frontend confidently; feature requests move from ask to production in days or a small number of weeks; deal-blocking requests stop needing founder involvement to land safely; recurring platform bugs

judul: 【GLUE事業部】 開発リーダー候補（モバイルアプリ開発）
teks: 当社は1994年創業のソフトウェアメーカーです。 法人に必要な3領域「セキュリティ・営業支援・業務効率化」で、 自社開発のパッケージソフトウェアとソリューションを提供しています。 ネットワークソリューション事業 IT資産管理、クライアントPCの運用管理とセキュリティ対策 セールスDXソリューション事業 名刺管理・SFA・MA・見込み客発掘まで一体で提供する営業支援DX AIデータエントリーソリューション事業 帳票エントリー業務の効率化 概要 ホットプロファイルは「営業を強くし売上を上げる。」をミッションに、名刺管理、営業支援（SFA）、マーケティング、新規開拓（企業DB）といった4領域の機能を開発・提供する営業支援SaaSです。2024年4月に新規上場し、2026年以降はSFA機能の大幅強化を順次リリースする計画を発表するなど、プロダクトへの投資を加速しています。 募集背景 ホットプロファイルのモバイル利用ユーザーは年々増加しており、モバイルアプリの開発は事業成長に重要な役割を担っています。 ユーザー数の増加と機能強化の加速にあわせて、製品企画と開発現場をつなぎ、モバイルアプリチームの開発サイクルを牽引していただく開発リーダーを募集することとなりました。 規模を拡大してもスピードと品質を失わない開発体制を、リーダーとして一緒につくっていただける方をお迎えしたいと考えています。 サービスについて 担当製品「ホットプロファイル」 ホットプロファイルは、名刺管理、営業支援（SFA）、マーケティングオートメーション（MA）を一つのプラットフォームで提供し、営業活動を強化するサービスです。最新のAI技術を搭載し、営業データの分析と提案を自動化することで、営業の生産性を向上させます。 営業支援SaaS『 ホットプロファイル 』 https://www.hammock.jp/hpr/ AI機能について https://www.hammock.jp/hpr/landing/202506cm.html 競合他社に対する優位性 ホットプロファイルは名刺管理、SFA、MA、新規開拓という4つの分野を一つのプラットフォームで提供できることが他社にはない強みになります。4つの分野を統合的に活用できることで複数のシステムを併用する必要がなくなり、コストを抑えたシームレスな運用を実現できます。比較サイト「ITreview」では名刺管理ソフト部門にて「ITreview Grid Award」を6期連続で受賞しており、業界内で高い評価を得ています 。現在では、ビックカメラ、IHI、三菱重工、商工中金などの多くの企業が導入しています。 技術的な面白さと醍醐味 非構造化データの構造化と、複雑なドメイン統合 名刺（画像）・商談音声（非構造化データ）・Web行動履歴（ログ）という異質なデータを、SFAの商談プロセス（構造化データ）とリアルタイムに紐づける難易度の高いDB設計が求められます。 単なるCRUDではなく、「多角的なデータをビジネスインサイトに変換するパイプライン」を構築するデータエンジニアリング的要素にも関わることができます。 RAG/LLMの「社会実装」への挑戦 ユーザーが日常的に使う業務フローの中に、LLMやRAG（検索拡張生成）を用いた「AI議事録」「提案書解析」などの機能を本番実装しています。自分のコードが日本の営業現場の生産性を直接変える手応えがあります。 開発組織について 現在 ホットプロファイルの開発部には、エンジニア、QAエンジニア、SREが50名ほど在籍しています。上記以外に事業部にはプロダクトマネージャー、デザイナーが在籍しており、Eng/PdM/デザイナー/QAが1チームとなって開発を進めるスクラム型開発スタイルを取り入れています。 チームの特徴 開発エンジニアは20代後半～30代がボリュームゾーンです。 開発フローはスクラムを採用しており、それに準じたタイムスパンで業務をおこなっています。 また、開発外では社内勉強会、ワークショップ、情報共有用チャット等でノウハウ共有やコミュニケーションの活性化を図っています。 本ポジションでは、モバイルアプリ開発チームリーダーとして、メンバー・パートナー企業メンバーで構成される～10名程度のチームをお任せします。 働き方 エンジニアチームは、基本はリモートメインで「深い集中（Deep Work）」を確保し、必要に合わせ出社し直接顔を合わせて意見交換やコラボレーションを行う機会を大切にしています。この取り組みにより、リモートワークとオフィス出社の良さを組み合わせた柔軟な働き方を実現しています。 ※入社直後は、キャッチアップ・開発環境の把握の為、1～2カ月程度出社を想定しています。 ※状況に応じてチームの出社頻度を変更する場合があります。 担当業務 本ポジションではモバイルアプリ開発チームのリーダーとして、正社員・パートナー企業メンバーで構成される～10名程度のチームをお任せします。 業務詳細 ・製品企画と連携した新機能の要件定義、プロジェクト計画の立案 ・基本設計、詳細設計、実装、単体テスト ・10名程度のチームの開発サイクルのマネジメント （進捗・品質・課題管理、設計レビュー・コードレビュー、メンバー育成、パートナー企業メンバーのディレクションを含む） 【重点テーマ例】 ・モバイルアプリの機能強化や品質向上、および新規機能開発 ・生成AIを活用した機能の開発や改善 ・生成AIツールを活用した開発プロセスの推進・改善 開発環境 開発言語：C＃、Flutter 環境：Linux、Windows、Amazon Web Service フレームワーク：jQuery、AWS Lambda データベース：MySQL、DynamoDB プロジェクト管理：Backlog、Git 生成AIツール：Cursor、Claude、Devin 情報共有ツール：Teams、SharePoint 応募条件 【必須条件（MUST）】 ・モバイルアプリ開発経験、またはWEBサービスのバックエンド開発の経験（どちらか3年以上） ・数名規模のチームマネジメント経験（2年以上） 【歓迎条件 （WANT）】 ・Flutter 開発実務経験 ・C#開発実務経験 ・DB（My SQL）の設計、実装の実務経験 ・SaaS製品の開発のご経験 ・生成AIを利用した開発経験 ・AWSの知見 求める人物像 ・新しい機能の開発を積極的に推進できる方 ・要件定義を丁寧にやり切り、製品企画と開発の橋渡しができる方 ・開発チームをまとめ、目標達成に導く高いコミュニケーション能力とリーダーシップを発揮できる方 この仕事で得られる経験、魅力 ・複数ドメイン（名刺管理・SFA・MAなど）にまたがる複雑な設計課題に、1プロダクトで触れられる ・LLM/RAGを本番実装するプロダクトで、生成AI活用を前提とした開発マネジメントの経験を積める
